messages:
Alex R.: Heads up: PR #4215 is a small fixes+link updates PR but it's been sitting without a reviewer. I want it in the tonight 19:00 PT merge window because it's blocking a downstream example. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4215. Can someone pick the prose review and someone else the CI/linkcheck?

Nina T.: I can do the prose review. Quick skim looked fine but I'll check the anchor changes and the wording around 'session state' consistency.

Caleb D.: I'm on infra duty but can take the linkcheck. If the docs-ci shows any 404s I can patch. Note: I'm out from 18:30 PT so need to merge before that or Omar will have to handle the window.

infra-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-4215 (status: failing linkcheck: 1 404)

Alex R.: The 404 looks related to an old example link in examples/auth.md. I pushed a quick fix in branch but didn't re-run CI. If you can retest Caleb that would be great.

Caleb D.: Retesting now, I fixed the path in the branch and re-run linkcheck locally. Also flagged a relative-image path that will break on the site build, pushed a patch.

Nina T.: Prose review done. Left two tiny wording suggestions and a note to clarify the "sticky session" paragraph for hosted vs dedicated. Approving after that one-line tweak.

Harpreet S.: I'm rotating into reviewer duty for the evening; can give a second set of eyes quickly. Also we should decide who actually clicks merge if it's green — I'm happy to do it but fine if Caleb does before 18:30.

Alex R.: Thanks everyone. I applied Nina's wording tweak and added a short clarifying sentence about sticky session behavior on dedicated. Re-ran CI locally.

infra-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-4215 (status: passing)

Caleb D.: CI green. I'll merge now (doing in 2 mins). If release team needs this on a branch afterwards let me know and I'll open backport.

Harpreet S.: Thanks Caleb. Quick follow-up: can we add this PR to docs/OWNERSHIP.md under "quick-fixes" so next rotation knows to pick up tiny link-only PRs? We keep seeing a backlog.

Nina T.: Good call. I can add a one-line ownership note in the morning. Also recommend adding a tiny label workflow or a "needs-linkcheck" auto-tag so infra reviewers can filter.

Alex R.: Agreed on the label. I'll open a separate issue for the automation. Thanks team 44aa
